1.title: Secret Service Agent and 2 Others Charged in Near-Fatal Fraternity Hazing
1.summary: A college fraternity member was paddled so severely during hazing rituals that he suffered kidney damage and nearly died.

2.title: Pentagon Changes How It Reports Casualties in Iran War
2.summary: The changes separated the casualty numbers into two separate web pages, potentially making it more difficult to tally the war’s full toll.

3.title: Ryan Gosling to join Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ghost Rider
3.summary: During a surprise announcement at San Diego Comic-Con, the actor says the character is one he has "wanted to play for a very long time".

4.title: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
4.summary: Mamdani walked back his threat last week, acknowledging he lacked the legal power to arrest Netanyahu on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court.

5.title: Extreme Heat and Strong Winds Fuel New Wildfires in France and Spain
5.summary: Firefighters are tackling fresh blazes while others have been contained, and hundreds of thousands of people have been forced to flee. A new heat wave forecast to hit Europe could make conditions worse.

6.title: Berlin Pride Event Attacker Killed in Police Shootout, Officials Say
6.summary: The confrontation with the suspect in what has been described as a likely act of Islamist terrorism occurred as a large-scale manhunt was underway, the authorities said.
